# João Carneiro

João Carneiro is a Portuguese visual artist and architect based in Lisbon, Portugal. The website presents selected works, studies, biography, CV, contact information and legal information in Portuguese and English.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://joao-carneiro.netlify.app/
- Works: https://joao-carneiro.netlify.app/works.html
- Studies: https://joao-carneiro.netlify.app/studies.html
- Biography: https://joao-carneiro.netlify.app/about.html
- CV: https://joao-carneiro.netlify.app/cv.html
- Contact: https://joao-carneiro.netlify.app/contact.html

## Rights
All artworks, images and texts are protected by copyright. Reproduction, distribution, publication or commercial use requires prior written authorization.

## Language
The website is available in Portuguese and English. Artwork titles remain unchanged.
